messages.\"他们只改了一个字。我把原字剪下来吞进肚里那天起，我说的每句话都慢半拍——因为: “They changed a single character. I cut out the original and swallowed it. Since that day, every word I speak comes half a beat late. The truth has to find its way around the salt first.”
messages.\"军令说失败者除名，所以我把他们的名字绣进了白纱。若你见到穿纱的东西跪在池边—: “The order struck anyone who failed from the rolls, so I stitched their names into white gauze. If you see something veiled kneeling beside the pool, look closely. What you took for a bride is the roll itself.”
messages.\"弦断那夜我还在唱。没了弦，我就把自己的喉咙调成那个音。别把我的心拿去敲钟——: “I was still singing the night the strings broke. With the strings gone, I tuned my throat to their note. Don't take my heart to strike the bell. It is an instrument now, and no hammer.”
messages.\"我锁了一百道门，最后才明白王要锁的不是井外的潮，是井里的人声。第一百零一把钥: “I locked a hundred doors before I understood what the king meant to shut away. The tide was outside the well. The voices he wanted were within. The hundred-and-first key, I swallowed.”
messages.\"誓牌上每个名字都是我亲手敲进去的。我沉下去，是替他们守着，等哪天有人来把名字: “I hammered every name into the oath plate with my own hands. I sank down to keep watch for them, until someone could come knock the names free, one by one. Three knocks are mine. The fourth comes from elsewhere.”
messages.\"那天我把心交出去时，钟里的欢呼还没停。我以为押上的是我自己——没人告诉我，押: “The cheering inside the bell hadn't stopped when I handed over my heart. I thought I was pledging myself. No one told me I was pledging the voices of every generation to come.”

messages.从温室西门沿西阶降到根须南廊，一路向东经蜂蜡暗屋攀上东藤壁，从棚架东角踏上树冠步: From the Greenhouse West Gate, take the west stairs down to South Root Gallery. Go east past the Hidden Wax House, climb the East Vine Wall and cross the canopy west from the trellis corner. At the West Lookout, find the Cracked Dome through the glass and jump into the Heartwood. Pull the Root Vault lever to open the spoke bridge loop, climb the branches back to the canopy and defeat the Copperroot Bishop beyond the Dome Approach.
messages.从王冠前厅沿东冠肩降入雨渠与弦室回声，顺东环廊走到核心竖井受控下坠；在钟舌库拉杆: From the Crown Foyer, descend the East Crown Shoulder through the Rain Canal and String Room echoes. Follow the East Ring Gallery to the Core Shaft and control your descent. Pull the lever in the Bell Clapper Vault to open the west ring gate. Climb back through the Obsidian, Saltwhite and Moss Court echoes, then take the one-way climb along the Crown Rib to the foyer. Face the Hundred-Key Gatekeeper at the Throne Approach below the core and ascend to choose an ending.
messages.从王冠正中取下的心，比其余五枚都轻——轻得像被预支了太多年。: A heart taken from the very center of the crown. Lighter than the other five, as if too many years had already been drawn against it.
messages.从盐晶门厅沿白书脊长廊登上烛台夹层，攀中庭书塔逐层探西二层阅览廊与东三层反页廊，: From the Salt Crystal Foyer, follow White Bookspine Gallery up to the Candlelit Mezzanine. Climb the Atrium Booktower to explore the reading gallery on the second floor west and Turnleaf Gallery on the third floor east. Cross the Skybridge of Salt and drop down the Slipping Page Shaft. Descend the Sealed Stacks to the eastern ground floor. Pull the lever in the Sealing Wax Vault to open the Salt Gate loop, then defeat the Ash-Crowned Mantis Warlord in Covenant Court.
messages.从破旗哨站沿山根向东，灰烬绞盘接通升降笼；西侧砌道绕回营火，再沿上段石路登瞭望塔: Go east from Torn Banner Outpost along the foot of the mountain. The ash winch connects the lift. The western stone path loops back to the campfire. Take the upper road to the watchtower. The mirror pool gate lies beyond the warm lamp at the summit. Follow the cave floor and gentle slopes. Press %s to call and ride the shaft lift. Open the shortcut to reach the boss. You can leave other enemies standing.

Shortcuts opened from the far side stay open. The echo bell summons an optional boss. Maintenance entrance in sight: Bellshell Guard Workshop. Press Q at the gate. The bellshell's vibration knocks the wax latch loose.
messages.从跪行小门后传出的告解，嗓音属于一个锁了一辈子门的人。: A confession from beyond a door so low you must pass on your knees. The voice belongs to someone who spent a lifetime locking doors.
messages.从黑曜哨站沿山根古道向东，借下段砌道之字爬回西侧的巡礼营地；再走上段砌道与瞭望塔: Head east from Obsidian Outpost along the Old Foothill Road. Climb the switchbacks of the Lower Stone Road to Pilgrim Camp in the west. Follow the Upper Stone Road and climb the Watchtower to the summit, then cross back over the Banner Bridge for a view of the road below. Defeat the Mirrorpool Bride and ride the Descent Cableway to the foothills. The cable car lever in the Ash Pit opens a direct loop between the foothills and camp.
messages.他到死都觉得那里应该有一扇门。: To his dying day he was sure there ought to be a door there.
messages.以中央钟庭为枢纽探索整座箱庭：上攀钟塔沿钟冠坠回，下探水窖拉通后门升梯，西入苔脉: Explore from Central Bell Court. Climb the tower and drop back from the Bell Crown. Descend to the cistern to open the back gate lift. Recover Crimson Dash in the Mossvein Maze to the west, then head east to Rustcrown Hall. Defeat the Moss Bell Matriarch to open the drainpipe to Rain Foundry Canal.
messages.以泵房中庭为枢纽探索三井叠瀑：沿渡槽匍匐坠入中庭，下探沉渠拉通泄洪梯，西入湿墙试: Explore the three waterfall shafts from the Pumphouse Atrium. Crawl along the aqueduct and drop into the atrium, then descend to the sunken canal to open the flood ladder. Reclaim Silk Wall Grip in the western Wetwall Trial and climb the Upper Water Tower. Defeat the Crimson Thread Scissor Apostle in Sunken Furnace Hall to the east. Recover the Echo Hook in the Pendulum Workshop, then leave for Saltwhite Archive through the Echo Outlet.

messages.你认得这个字——缮。修补，与誊写。: You know this character: Shan. To mend, and to make a fair copy.

messages.全馆唯一不结盐的木匣里，装着半拍之后的声音。: In the only wooden box in the archive untouched by salt lies a voice half a beat late.
messages.六枚并在一处时，它们的跳动会慢慢对齐。: Bring all six together, and little by little their beating falls into time.
messages.内侧有半个刻字的起笔，落笔处被凿断——凿痕很新。: Inside is the start of an engraved character. A chisel cuts the stroke short. The chisel mark is fresh.

messages.凑近辨认唇形——是一个名字的后半段。: Lean close and read its lips. The second half of a name.
messages.出示第五区巡礼印。: Show the pilgrim's mark from the fifth region.
messages.出示第六区巡礼印。: Show the pilgrim's mark from the sixth region.

messages.删除「%s」？当前装备、资源和其它方案保留。: Delete “%s”? You keep your current equipment, resources and other loadouts.
messages.别拿它当锤用——它是乐器。: Don't wield it like a hammer. It is an instrument.

messages.双线跃已会：返回运书索道，穿过盐风封门，带回失名证词。: You can now double-jump. Return to the booklift, cross the saltwind gate and bring back the nameless testimony.

messages.取得静靴后，在钟龛将它装入行旅饰件槽。: Find the Quiet Boots, then equip them in a travel charm slot at a bell shrine.

messages.只控制钟龛尾声和泵渠旧物；危险预警、角色、受击闪光与声音不变。独立保存，不随分享: Affects shrine effects and pumphouse relics. Danger cues, characters, hit flashes and audio keep their own settings. Saved separately on this device.

messages.只显示已解锁且兼容当前所选槽位的装备。: Show unlocked gear compatible with the selected slot.
messages.只有两份记录均可读取时才能核对差异。: Both saves must be readable to compare them.
messages.只比较以上资源和记录数量；数量相同不代表剧情、地图或装备内容相同。: These figures compare resources and records. Story, map and equipment details may differ even when the counts match.
messages.只移动标记，不移动角色；保留原编号，不占用新的图钉名额。: Moves only the pin. It keeps its number and uses no extra pin slot.
messages.可与既有同族饰件组合，仍受契印容量和槽位限制。: Can be combined with existing charms of the same family. Your seal's capacity and slot limits still apply.
messages.可以恢复 · 不花碎钱或材料: Ready to restore · No coins or materials required
messages.可诱导小怪调查落点，之后可重新发现玩家；Boss免疫。 补给消耗碎钱与材料。: Lesser enemies investigate the landing site and can find you again afterward. Bosses ignore the lure. Restocking costs coins and materials.
messages.可诱导小怪调查落点，之后可重新发现玩家；Boss免疫。 钟龛可用碎钱与花蜡补给。: Draws lesser enemies to investigate where the bell lands. They can find you again afterward. Bosses ignore it. Restock at a bell shrine with coins and flower wax.
messages.右键标记已补绘房间 · 上方按钮支持键盘/手柄 · 最多12个: Right-click a surveyed room to pin it · Buttons support keyboard and controller · Up to 12 pins
messages.右键：在已购且已补绘房间放置所选类型图钉 · 左键拖动 / WASD / 左摇杆: Right-click a surveyed room on a purchased map to place the selected pin. Pan: left-drag / WASD / left stick · Zoom: wheel / PgUp/PgDn / RB/LB · Reset: Home / Y
messages.名称最多24字；留空恢复默认。可选择移至当前位置，需要罗盘或导航辅助，目标须已补: Use up to 24 characters. Leave blank for the default name. To move the pin to your current location, the room must be surveyed and you need a compass or Navigation Assist. Your character stays in place.
messages.后门升梯 · 直回钟庭: Back Gate Lift · Direct return to Bell Court
messages.向任一地区的地图商人购买: Buy from a map seller in any region.
messages.唤醒捷径钟门的锈蚀战斗标记。: A rusted combat token that wakes the shortcut bell gate.
messages.商人说它\"存得住声音\"，拿它换货比拿话换货可靠——这是无声之世的金本位。: The merchants say it “holds a sound.” In a voiceless world, a shard buys more surely than a promise. It is the coin all others are measured by.
messages.四百年来一直有人补凿，不许这个字长回来。: For four hundred years someone has been cutting it back, lest the character grow again.
messages.回响诱铃·巡礼二阶改制: Echo Lure Bell · Pilgrim Upgrade II
messages.图上有一间没有画门的房间，被人用指甲反复划过。: One room on the map has no door. Someone has scratched at it again and again with a fingernail.
messages.图钉未能保存，本次修改已撤回。: Couldn't save the pin. Your change was rolled back.
messages.在游戏内阅读发行包附带的项目与第三方来源文件。: Read the project credits and third-party sources included with this release.

messages.在门前按住 {key:lantern_phase} 进入相位，留足绯线。: Hold {key:lantern_phase} at the gate to phase through. Keep some thread in reserve.
messages.地图商人出售：钟楼报时骨片磨成的指针。: Map sellers stock this compass. Its needle was ground from a piece of the belltower's timekeeping bone.
messages.地图已关闭或区域正在切换。: The map has closed or the region is changing.
messages.地面敲击钟器向前震波，空中不可用；司铸可消耗钟压。: Strike the bell against the ground to send a wave forward. Requires firm footing. The Bellfounder's Seal can spend Bell Pressure.
messages.地面移动提高8%；不增加跳高。: Increases ground speed by 8%. Jump height stays the same.
messages.地面移动速度提高5%；不增加跳高。: Increases ground speed by 5%. Jump height stays the same.
messages.地面移动速度提高6%，受到的击退提高15%；不改变跳跃或永久能力。: Ground speed increases by 6%, but you take 15% more knockback. Jumping and permanent abilities are unchanged.
messages.地面陷阱，最多两个；Boss不被定身。 补给消耗碎钱与材料。: Deploy up to two ground traps. Bosses resist the root. Restocking costs coins and materials.
messages.地面陷阱，最多两个；Boss不被定身。 钟龛可用碎钱与湿壳补给。: Set up to two traps on the ground. Bosses resist the root. Restock at a bell shrine with coins and Damp Shells.
messages.墨下的旧字被盐刮过，但纸背的笔压还在。: Salt has scraped at the older writing beneath, but the pen strokes still press through the back.
messages.壳面映不出你的脸，只映出你身后的路。: The shell reflects only the road behind you. You search in vain for your face.
messages.备份文件时间早于主档。: The backup is older than the main save.
messages.备份文件时间晚于主档。: The backup is newer than the main save.
messages.复盘记录未写入，仍保留本次内存记录。: Couldn't save the review. Its details are still available for this session.

messages.天顶盐桥 → 滑页井: Skybridge of Salt → Slipping Page Shaft
messages.头顶的裂口通向钟隙渡口。 可见旧检修入口：「无名钟契库」。靠近旧钟门按 %s，消: The rift overhead leads to Bellgap Crossing. Maintenance entrance in sight: Nameless Bell Covenant Vault. At the old bell gate, press %s and spend energy to reconnect the covenant lock.
messages.头顶的裂口通向钟隙渡口。 可见旧检修入口：「无名钟契库」。靠近旧钟门按 R，消耗: The rift overhead leads to Bellgap Crossing. Maintenance entrance in sight: Nameless Bell Covenant Vault. At the old bell gate, press R and spend energy to reconnect the covenant lock.
messages.契约原本的残片，\"暂借\"二字上覆着一层新墨。: A scrap of the original covenant. Fresh ink covers the characters for “on loan.”
messages.奖励记录未写入，请重试。: Couldn't save the reward. Please try again.
messages.她是六人中唯一还醒着的。替其余五个听清楚。: Of the six, she alone is still awake. Listen closely for the other five.
messages.存档切换失败；当前进度未被覆盖。: Couldn't switch saves. Your current progress is intact.
messages.存档所在的区域不在当前巡礼路线中；进度全部保留，从巡礼起点继续。: Your saved region is outside the current route. You will resume at the start with all your progress.
messages.它原本记的不是路，是钟声传到每间屋子的时刻表。: It used to keep a timetable of each room and the moment the bellsong reached it.
messages.它在朝一个方向轻轻使劲——朝着雨声的方向。: It tugs ever so slightly in one direction. Toward the sound of rain.
messages.它开的那扇门，在井底。: The door it opens is at the bottom of the well.
messages.它记得每一个跟它走过这条路的人。: It remembers everyone who walked this road beside it.
messages.它还在等一份改好的文书。: It is still waiting for a document to be put right.

messages.完成巡礼契约后交工匠编制。: Complete the pilgrimage contract, then have the artisan weave it.
messages.完整阅读当前地图的路线/危险说明和图钉提示；支持键盘和手柄焦点。: Read route notes, hazards and pin details for this map. Use the keyboard or controller to move focus.
messages.定位条件或当前位置已变化，请重新打开编辑。: Your known position has changed. Reopen the editor.
messages.定身时间更长，仍短于冷却，不能连锁定身：适合控场。: Holds enemies longer. The hold still ends before the cooldown, so you cannot keep a target rooted indefinitely.
messages.实线是实体钟管；悬停或方向键聚焦房间可查看旧路端点关系。箭头分别表示正反向规则允: Solid lines mark physical bell pipes. Hover over a room or focus it with the arrows to inspect its connections. Arrows show permitted directions. A bar means access is restricted from both sides. You still need to reach the passage in person.
messages.对齐之后的那一拍，叫做钟声。: The beat that follows is the ringing of a bell.
messages.寻找低处检修台遗留的攀壁线爪；雨溢立管在上方，钟庭在来路。: Look for the wall-climbing claws on the lower maintenance platform. The overflow riser is above. The bell court lies behind you.
messages.封在盐晶里的心，看得见，摸不着棱角。: A heart sealed in salt crystal. You can see its edges, but your fingers cannot find them.
messages.封蜡库：盐门拉杆: Sealing Wax Vault: Salt Gate lever
messages.封蜡账册记着书库给盐瓶封蜡的比例，蜂蜡商人一看就认出是自家旧蜡。: The wax ledger records the archive's mix for sealing salt flasks. The Wax Merchant recognizes the old family wax at a glance.
messages.射程大幅加长：适合从远台点名。: Greatly extends range. Pick off targets from a distant platform.
messages.巡礼军墓里阵亡旗手背带上的承力扣，改铸后能多挂一件行旅铭饰：三枚契印的第三个行旅: A clasp from a fallen standard-bearer's harness in the soldiers' tomb. Recasting it lets you wear another travel Charms. All three seals need it for their third travel Charms slot.
messages.巡礼升降笼：F 呼叫 / 乘坐: Pilgrim Lift: F to call or ride

messages.工匠还不会这门手艺: This artisan hasn't learned that craft yet.
messages.工头说过：人可以沉，牌不能沉。: The foreman used to say, “A worker may sink. The badge must stay afloat.”

messages.已恢复当前槽备份。: Backup restored to the current slot.

messages.带着它，命令声会绕开你半步。: Carry it, and the voice of command gives you half a step of room.
messages.干扰普通远程敌人索敌；不影响已发射弹体。 补给消耗碎钱与材料。: Disrupts ordinary ranged enemies' aim. Projectiles already in flight continue on course. Restocking costs coins and materials.
messages.干扰普通远程敌人索敌；不影响已发射弹体。 钟龛可用碎钱与盐晶补给。: Disrupts ordinary ranged enemies' aim. Projectiles already in flight continue on course. Restock at a bell shrine with coins and salt crystals.
messages.庭中古树被钟声震裂时渗出的树脂，凝成小块，敲起来有闷闷的回音。: When the bells cracked the ancient trees of the court, resin seeped out and hardened into little lumps. Tap one for a muffled echo.
messages.归途结尚未写入；碎钱与结保持原状，可再次找回。: Couldn't save the Return Knot. The knot and its coins are intact. Try recovering them again.

messages.归途记录暂停写入，暂不能修改图钉。: Saving is paused. Pins cannot be changed right now.

messages.心愿尚未确认，请重试。: Wish not yet confirmed. Please try again.
messages.快缝：耗60绯线，0.55秒缝回1格，可在空中缝补；完成后地面移速短暂提高，不增: Quick Stitch: Spend 60 thread to mend 1 HP in 0.55s, even in midair. Finishing briefly boosts ground speed. Jump height stays the same.
messages.恢复不补充生命、绯线或次数，不清空冷却；超出新上限的生命与绯线会截断。: Restoring leaves HP, thread, charges and cooldowns as they are. HP and thread are capped at the new maximums.

messages.恢复将使用上面的备份进入旅途；现有主档会另存保留，备份不被覆盖。: Restoring continues the journey from this backup. The existing main save will be kept separately and the backup will be preserved.
messages.悬停／方向键选择房间：查看上下层邻室；邻接不表示道路已开放。: Hover or use the arrow keys to select a room and see adjacent floors. A neighboring room may still be blocked.
messages.战具已用尽，请在钟龛补给: Tool depleted. Restock at a bell shrine.
messages.战具未能启动且退款暂未写入；本次次数已消耗: The tool failed to activate. Its use was spent because the refund could not be saved.
messages.戴着它，你说的每句话都会回到你自己耳中——在无声之城，这是一种奢侈。: Wear it, and every word you speak returns to your own ear. In the silent city, that is a luxury.
messages.打了死结的绯线，攥紧就不冷。: Crimson thread tied in a knot that will never slip. Close your hand around it for warmth.
messages.打开主动观察设置；右侧滑条仍调整自动前瞻。: Open manual camera settings. The slider on the right still adjusts automatic look-ahead.
messages.找回被删去的名字，接通旧运书线。: Recover the erased name and reopen the old booklift.
messages.承力缝：须落地，耗80绯线，1.15秒缝回2格；被打断只损失一半。完成后一次限时: Bracing Stitch: On the ground, spend 80 thread to mend 2 HP in 1.15s. Interruption costs half. For a short time after you finish, you can resist knockback once. The hit still deals damage.
messages.承接原有改制，再加一格携带上限；当前余量不增加，仍需付费补给。: Builds on the first upgrade. Carrying capacity increases by one more. Current stock stays the same. Pay to restock as usual.
messages.把已知图钉移到视野内；跨区图钉使用世界图，不移动角色。: Center the view on a known pin. Pins in another region open the world map. Your character stays in place.
messages.抛物线投掷，落地后提示再爆裂；不穿墙。 补给消耗碎钱与材料。: The jar arcs through the air and signals before bursting on the ground. Walls stop it. Restocking costs coins and materials.
messages.抛物线投掷，落地后提示再爆裂；不穿墙。 钟龛可用碎钱与苔壳补给。: Lob the jar in an arc. A tell marks its landing before it explodes. Walls block it. Restock at a bell shrine with coins and Moss Shells.
messages.拉开深井返程升梯: Release the Deep Well return lift
messages.拾取记录未写入；物件、能力与资源保持原状，按交互键重试。: Pickup not saved. The item, ability and resources are intact. Press Interact to retry.
messages.拾得碎钱与材料 · 绯线回充: Coins and materials gained · Thread restored
messages.拿走它，记得替它继续转。: If you take it, remember to keep it turning.
messages.指腹抚过背面，有细密的压痕——拒绝执行时的免责条款，用不出声的方式写给不敢看的人: Run a fingertip over the back. Fine indentations spell out a clause absolving anyone who refuses the order. It was written in silence, for those afraid to look.
messages.按 %s 交谈，购买本区地图。: Press %s to talk and buy a map of this region.
messages.按 %s 休息，恢复状态并记录归途。: Press %s to rest, recover and save your journey.
messages.按 %s 使用战具；在钟龛休息可补满次数。: Press %s to use a tool. Rest at a bell shrine to replenish its uses.
messages.按 %s 冲刺越过缺口；空中也能使用。: Press %s to dash across the gap. You can dash in midair, too.
messages.按 %s 取回遗落物资。: Press %s to recover your lost supplies.
messages.按 %s 开启钟门。: Press %s to open the bell gate.
messages.按 %s 挥刃，命中敌人可回充绯线。: Press %s to strike. Hitting enemies restores thread.
messages.按 %s 查看归途的选择。: Press %s to see how your journey could end.
messages.按 %s 看地图，亮起的房间就是你已经走过的路。: Press %s for the map. Lit rooms mark the places you've visited.
messages.按 %s 跳跃；提前松开可跳得更低。: Press %s to jump. Release early for a shorter jump.
messages.按 %s 通过旧通路。: Press %s to take the old passage.
messages.按 M 看地图，亮起的房间就是你已经走过的路。: Press M for the map. Lit rooms mark the places you've visited.
messages.按住 %s 穿黑曜影门，能量不足时先等巡礼军收招。: Hold %s to pass through the obsidian shadow gate. If you're low on energy, wait until the pilgrimage soldiers finish their attack.
messages.按封蜡账册的配方封口，瓶身更薄、装得更多：携带上限 +1。: The wax ledger gives a seal that holds with thinner glass. You can carry one extra flask.
messages.按治疗键缝补伤口；消耗、回复量与能否空中缝补由所装契印决定，详见构筑页的契印说明: Press Heal to stitch your wounds. Your seal determines the cost, the healing amount and whether you can mend in midair. See its description under Build.
messages.按装备名称搜索。搜索与筛选不会执行装备操作或消耗资源。: Search by equipment name. Searching and filtering won't equip items or spend resources.
messages.挥刃命中会回充绯线；留一些给缝补和战技。: Landing a strike restores thread. Save some for mending and skills.
messages.据说缮织它时，把\"开始\"和\"结束\"缝在了一起。: They say that when Shan wove it, the Mender stitched “beginning” and “ending” together.
messages.携带量不足上限；可在钟龛购买部分补给。: Below capacity. You can buy a partial refill at a bell shrine.
messages.攀壁已会：雨溢立管通向书库；排水钟管随时可以返回钟庭。: You can now climb walls. The overflow riser leads to the archive. The drainpipe takes you back to the bell court.
messages.攥久了会在掌心微微发烫，像有什么想被听见。: Hold it awhile and it warms in your palm, as though something wanted you to hear it.
messages.改制不附带次数；多出的一份在钟龛按原价补给。: Upgrading increases capacity. Buy the extra charge at a bell shrine for the usual price.
messages.效果只在装备后计算；不改变永久探索能力。: Takes effect when equipped. Permanent exploration abilities are unchanged.
messages.效果由契印统一计算，不影响永久探索能力。: Your seal determines the effect. Permanent exploration abilities are unchanged.
messages.文件时间不能判断路线、结局或装备哪一份更合意；请进入原核对窗口阅读差异。: Timestamps cannot tell you which route, ending or equipment you prefer. Open the comparison to see what differs.
messages.断弦温室·根网追踪首清取得「证据·根网爪痕」（只作图样，不会被收走）: Clear the Rootweb Hunt in Broken String Greenhouse to obtain the Rootweb Claw Marks. They serve as a pattern and stay with you.
messages.断弦温室·根须南廊：把会走动的敌人引开，再逐个处理。: Broken String Greenhouse, South Root Gallery: lure the roaming enemies away and take them on one at a time.
messages.断弦温室·蜂蜡影闩室门外的练习傀儡，会跟着你走。练习区内使用不消耗次数。: Broken String Greenhouse: the dummy outside the Beeswax Shadowlatch Chamber follows you. Practice uses no charges.
messages.断弦温室·蜂蜡试炼首清取得「证据·蜂蜡余响」（只作图样，不会被收走）: Clear the Beeswax Trial in Broken String Greenhouse to obtain the Beeswax Echo evidence. It serves as a pattern and stays with you.
messages.断弦温室·蜂蜡试炼首清后，向蜂蜡商人出示「证据·蜂蜡余响」。: Clear the Beeswax Trial in Broken String Greenhouse, then show the Beeswax Echo evidence to the Wax Merchant.
messages.断旗桥下的灯火: A Light Under the Broken Banner Bridge
messages.旅途记录、规划与只读分析；辅助记录按存档槽隔离。: Review your journey, plan routes and inspect progress. Companion records are kept separately for each save slot.
messages.旗上的名字没有烧掉——名字烧不掉，它们只是换了个地方排队。: The names on the banners survived the fire. Names do not burn. They have simply formed ranks elsewhere.
messages.旗桥壁龛黑曜片: Obsidian Shard from the Banner Bridge Niche
messages.无声王冠·钟舌试炼首清后，带冠响碎片回铸雨渠找雨铸匠。: Clear the Clapper Trial at the Silent Crown, then take the crown echo shards to the Rain Foundry Smith in Rain Foundry Canal.
messages.旧支线 → 断弦温室试玩章: Old branch → Broken String Greenhouse demo
messages.旧旅途无法安全备份，当前记录已保留。: Couldn't safely back up the old journey. The current save is intact.
messages.旧旅途无法安全备份，未开始新旅途，原记录已保留。: Couldn't back up your old journey. Your save is intact and a new journey hasn't started.
messages.旧路暂未接通，仍留在当前区域。: The old passage is closed. You are still in the same region.
messages.旧路目标入口记录无效。: This passage has an invalid destination entrance.
messages.普攻回能提高10%，治疗准备时间增加12%；与工匠线轴、逆潮线轴互斥。: Basic attacks restore 10% more thread, but mending takes 12% longer to start. Incompatible with the Artisan's Spool and Countertide Spool.
messages.普攻回能提高20%，技能伤害降低10%。: Basic attacks restore 20% more thread. Skills deal 10% less damage.
messages.最后一小节的指法，在弦断之后是弹不出来的——: Once the strings have snapped, the final bar is impossible to play…
messages.最后的巡礼之路已经开启。: The final pilgrimage route is open.
messages.有些门要走完一遍所有的路，才肯承认你来过。: Some doors will only acknowledge that you came after you have walked every road once.
messages.有人把没能贴出去的话，磨成了粉。: Someone ground to dust the words they never got to post.
messages.朝圣断阶：安全试跳: Broken Pilgrim Steps: practice jumping here
messages.朝圣者冢碑列平台上的旧军令，按 %s 收取后可交付逃旗者。: An old military order lies on the stone platform in Pilgrim's Rest. Press %s to pick it up and deliver it to the deserter.
messages.朝圣者冢碑列平台上的旧军令，按 F 收取后可交付逃旗者。: An old military order lies on the stone platform in Pilgrim's Rest. Press F to pick it up and deliver it to the deserter.
messages.朝圣阶（封）· 机关在对侧: Pilgrim Steps (sealed) · Mechanism on the far side
messages.本区巡礼印与旧图样互相参照，完成第一阶后再由原工匠改制。: The local pilgrim's mark and old pattern complement each other. After making the first upgrade, return to the same artisan.
messages.本区捷径均已接通。: All shortcuts in this region are open.
messages.本区敌群已清 · 钟门道路开启: Region cleared · The path to the bell gate is open
messages.本次已生效，未保存。: Active for this session. Changes are unsaved.

messages.来路与返程都已标在地图上。继续探索，或带着新证据返回旧地。: The map shows the way forward and the way back. Explore farther, or revisit old places with new evidence.
messages.构筑使用键盘、鼠标按钮或非导航手柄按键；确认、返回、方向键和滚轮保留给界面。Es: For Build, use a key, mouse button or non-navigation controller button. Confirm, Back, arrows and the wheel control the menus. Esc / Pad B to cancel.
messages.构筑存档不兼容，当前不能保存交易: This build save is incompatible. Transactions cannot be saved.
messages.构筑系统在互联世界旅途中开放: Builds unlock in the connected world.
messages.架势窗口更短、收势更快：要求更准，接住后更快反击。: A shorter guard window with faster recovery. Time it well to counter sooner.
messages.架势窗口更长，更容易接住攻击：适合稳守。: Stay in stance longer for a more forgiving block.
messages.查看三槽与备份总览: View all three slots and backups
messages.查看各区最近安坐的钟龛；先在当前钟龛安坐，再沿已开放钟路返回。: See the last shrine you rested at in each region. Rest at this shrine first, then return along an open bell route.
messages.查看遗留碎钱、已知落点与召回取舍；不会移动角色或花费资源。: Check lost coins, their last known location and your recall options. Viewing is free and leaves your character in place.
messages.柳说：别把它敲响。牌子会记仇。: Liu says, “Don't make it ring. The plate holds grudges.”
messages.校录缝：须落地，只耗50绯线，0.9秒缝回1格；延长附近已有盐记一次，不能反复延: Scribe's Stitch: On the ground, spend 50 thread to mend 1 HP in 0.9s. Extends nearby Salt Marks once each.
messages.根据所选分类查看行装。: View gear in the selected category.
messages.根须影管通向王冠，需要灯影相位；先去黑曜营地，或沿来路回书库。: The rootshade conduit leads to the crown and requires Lantern Phase. Head to Obsidian Camp first, or return to the archive.
messages.根须沉睡钟旧事: History of the Slumbering Root Bell

messages.检修支线 → 双层水位记录室: Maintenance branch → Two-Level Water Gauge Room
messages.检修支线 → 无名钟契库: Maintenance branch → Nameless Bell Covenant Vault
messages.检修支线 → 旧铸工证物柜: Maintenance branch → Foundry Worker's Evidence Locker

messages.检修支线 → 盐脊碎板井: Maintenance branch → Salt Ridge Plate Shaft
messages.检修支线 → 钟冠双线仓: Maintenance branch → Bell Crown Twin-Thread Storehouse

messages.歌页上没有词，只有指法。: A page of song without words. It holds only the fingering.
messages.正在查看图钉 %d；角色与旅途进度不变。: Viewing pin %d. Your character and progress are unchanged.
messages.此条目与目标位置不兼容，装备请求会被拒绝。: This item cannot be equipped in the selected slot.
messages.此输入保留给界面快捷键，请换一个输入，或按 Esc／手柄 B 取消。: The interface uses this shortcut. Choose another, or press Esc / Pad B to cancel.

messages.此输入需要留给界面导航；构筑请改用字母/功能键、鼠标按钮或非导航手柄按键。: This input navigates menus. For Build, use a letter key, function key, mouse button or non-navigation controller button.
messages.此页暂无可用条目。: No entries on this page yet.
messages.残页边缘的\"看不懂的钟文\"，其实是倒着写的普通字——绘图师最后的防删名手段。: The “illegible bell script” along the torn edge is ordinary writing, backwards. The cartographer's last defense against the scraping away of names.
messages.母株根系里存着的一小节清唱，音准好得让人心碎。: A bar of unaccompanied song kept in the mother plant's roots. The pitch is heartbreakingly true.
messages.水声变空的渠底: The Canal Bed Where the Water Sounds Hollow
messages.水声里析出的一段锤语，节拍极稳。: A message hammered out of the sound of running water. The rhythm never wavers.
messages.沉在水窖的纺锤，四百年没停转。: A spindle that sank into a cistern and spun on for four hundred years.
messages.沉过四百年井水的心，铁壳上锤痕层层叠叠，全出自同一只手。: A heart that lay four hundred years in well water. Hammer marks lie thick upon its iron shell, every one struck by the same hand.
messages.没人喂它丝，它就纺水声、纺苔息、纺你路过时的心跳。: With no silk to feed it, it spins the sound of water, the breath of moss, the beat of your heart as you pass.
messages.治疗准备时间缩短12%，受到的击退提高15%；治疗耗线与回复量不变。: Mending windup is reduced by 12%. You take 15% more knockback. Thread cost and healing remain the same.
messages.治疗完成后短暂降低状态积累，不清除已有状态。: Finishing a mend briefly slows status buildup. Existing effects remain.
messages.沿烛台阅览支线寻找双线跃；先前的雨渠入口仍可返回。: Follow the candlelit reading branch to find Double Jump. The rain canal entrance is still open behind you.
messages.沿路牌箭头步行进入通道，可沿来路折返。: Follow the sign's arrow into the passage. You can return the same way.
messages.泄洪栈梯 · 直回泵房: Flood Ladder · Direct return to Pumphouse
messages.泵井坠道 ↓ 回程走泄洪梯: Pump Shaft Drop ↓ Return by the flood ladder
messages.泵房中庭：上读表 · 西攀管 · 下探渠 · 东讨炉: Pumphouse Atrium: gauges above · pipes west · canal below · furnace east
messages.泵房吊龛湿壳: Damp Shell from the Hanging Pumphouse Shrine
messages.泵房钟板后的湿壳: Damp Shell Behind the Pumphouse Bell Plate
messages.洞内沿地面与缓坡前进；竖井升降笼按 %s 呼叫和乘坐。寻找并接通捷径即可开启 B: Follow the cave floor and gentle slopes. Press %s to call and ride the shaft lift. Open the shortcut to reach the boss. You can leave other enemies standing.
messages.洞内沿地面与缓坡前进；竖井升降笼按 F 呼叫和乘坐。寻找并接通捷径即可开启 Bo: Follow the cave floor and gentle slopes. Press F to call and ride the shaft lift. Open the shortcut to reach the boss. You can leave other enemies standing.

Moving, jumping, dashing or taking damage interrupts healing and costs %d thread.
messages.消耗30点能量，打出一次重型线刃。: Spend 30 energy to strike with a heavy threadblade.
messages.渠底猎物爪痕拓出的扣法，改铸后能多挂一件战斗铭饰：三枚契印的第三个战斗铭饰槽都需: Fashioned after the grip recorded in claw marks on the canal bed. Recasting it lets you wear another combat Charms. All three seals need it for their third combat Charms slot.
messages.渠影爪痕记下了猎物扑咬时的受力方向；织线学徒照着它把扣环反过来缝。: The Canalshade's claw marks show the force of its lunge. The Threadweaver's Apprentice reverses the loop to match that pull.
messages.渠影追踪的爪痕显示逆水时如何收紧线圈，雨铸匠据此反绕线轴。: Claw marks from the Canalshade Hunt show how the coil pulled tight against the current. The Rain Foundry Smith wound this spool in reverse.
messages.渡槽夹层：不下雨的房间: Aqueduct Mezzanine: a room sheltered from the rain
messages.温室园工报剪枝节拍的小铃，由雨铸匠铸铃舌，配上传声弦。: Gardeners rang this bell to keep time while pruning. The Rain Foundry Smith cast its clapper and fitted a string to carry the sound.
messages.温室西门：安全试跳: Greenhouse West Gate: practice jumping here
messages.滤芯里偶尔粘着极小的字纸——温室的花粉里，混着碎掉的求声帖。: Tiny scraps of writing sometimes cling to the filter. Shredded voice pleas drift among the greenhouse pollen.
messages.潮影中的轮班表: Shift Roster in the Tide's Shadow
messages.灰旗的针迹显示如何收住散线，织线学徒把旧旗环缝成较沉的收针环。: Stitches in the ash banner show how to gather loose thread. The apprentice sewed an old banner ring into a heavier needle ring.
messages.炉底：铸渣滑道（封）→ 黑曜巡礼路: Furnace Floor: slag chute (sealed) → Obsidian Pilgrim Road
messages.点到名的人，请回答。: When your name is called, answer.
messages.照根网猎物循声的爪痕改短铃舌，小铃也够响：携带上限 +1。: Claw marks show how the rootweb quarry follows sound. A shorter clapper lets a smaller bell ring loudly enough. Carrying capacity +1.
messages.牌沉了，就真的没来过了。: If the badge goes under, it is as though the worker was never here.
messages.物品记录尚未写入，留在原地可重试收取。: Couldn't save the pickup. Stay here to retry.
messages.王冠与温室、黑曜两路汇合；取得共鸣后，可回旧区检修钟门寻找反证。: The greenhouse and obsidian paths meet at the crown. Once you gain Resonance, search the old regions' maintenance gates for counterevidence.
messages.王冠前厅：认清六向: Crown Foyer: find your bearings at the six paths
messages.现在中断会损失 %d 绯线，最多退回 %d 绯线。: Interrupting now costs %d thread and returns up to %d.
messages.现在你知道该在井边数什么了。: Now you know what to count beside the well.
messages.用 %s / %s 移动，沿苔灯走向断阶。: Move with %s / %s. Follow the moss lamps to the broken steps.
messages.用当前装备覆盖「%s」？旧方案将被替换。: Overwrite “%s” with your current gear? This replaces the old loadout.
messages.用蜂蜡固定的小绕轴，能同时绕住两种线技：三枚契印的第二个线技槽都需要它。: A beeswax-fixed spindle that holds two thread skills at once. All three seals need it for their second skill slot.
messages.白纱夹层里绣出的一段点名册，针脚是行伍的间距。: A roll call embroidered between layers of white gauze. The stitches keep a soldier's spacing.
messages.盐保存一切，也腌死一切；这颗心慢了半拍，却从未停跳。: Salt keeps everything. Salt pickles everything dead. This heart beats half a beat late, yet it has never stopped.
messages.盐晶门厅：安全试跳: Salt Crystal Foyer: practice jumping here
messages.盐白书库·封存书堆：先罩住远程擦除的法警，再处理近身的书虫。: Saltwhite Archive, Sealed Stacks: shroud the bailiff who erases at a distance, then deal with the bookworms up close.
messages.盐白书库·封蜡库余响首清取得「证据·封蜡账册」（只作图样，不会被收走）: Clear the Sealing Wax Vault Echo in Saltwhite Archive to obtain the Wax Ledger evidence. It serves as a pattern and stays with you.
messages.盐白书库·运书吊篮仓门外的练习傀儡，会射出无害的练习光束。练习区内使用不消耗次数: Saltwhite Archive: the dummy outside the booklift storehouse fires a harmless practice beam. Practice uses no charges.
messages.盐白书库收存盐粉的封蜡小瓶，沿用压页台旁的旧配比。: A wax-sealed powder flask from Saltwhite Archive. Its salt mix follows the old proportions kept beside the page press.
messages.盐白书库核对删名记录后复原的校录印记。: Restored in Saltwhite Archive after the records of erased names were checked.
messages.盐白沉睡钟旧事: History of the Slumbering Saltwhite Bell
messages.盐记：回声针施加，盐印缚线消耗；治疗仅延长一次。: Salt Mark: Echo Needle applies a mark and Salt Snare consumes it. Mending can extend a mark once.
messages.盐风口暂不可通。沿下庭排水钟管去雨渠，也可先探索庭内捷径。: The saltwind pass is closed. Follow the lower court's drainpipe to the rain canal, or explore the court's shortcuts first.
messages.盐风走廊：双线跃可达（回访）: Saltwind Corridor: return with Double Thread Jump
messages.目标 / 留意 / 回访 · 最多12个 · 右键标记，左键仍拖动 · 可用手柄: Objective / Note / Return · Up to 12 pins · Right-click to place, left-drag to pan. Controller users can focus the buttons.

messages.相关人物回应或发现遗物后解锁: Unlocks through the relevant character's response or the discovery of a relic.
messages.短暂准备后向前突刺；不穿墙、不带无敌。缝名线势仅增加攻击范围。: A brief windup, then a lunge forward. Walls stop it and you can take damage throughout. Namestitch Momentum increases only its reach.
messages.短距离快速针击；高反弹下劈。: Quick, short-range needle strikes. Downstrikes bounce high.
messages.破损的镜片，会记住你走过的房间。: A cracked lens that remembers the rooms you have passed through.
